- That VEHICLE model's attacks have +1 to hit rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

Long Description:
Get Back in da Race (Once per battle round, per army): In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly SPEED FREEKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit (and any units embarked within that unit):
- Is no longer battle-shocked.
- Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

- Has +4" M

Long Description:
They'll Learn Ya (Once per battle, per unit): When this unit becomes battle-shocked, if this unit contains 1+ Gretchin models, you can roll one D6:
- That number of Gretchin models in this unit are destroyed.
- This unit is no longer battle-shocked.

Long Description:
Madcap Artillery: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if all ranged weapons equipped by each Mek Gunz model in this unit are the same, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit has the ability below that matches that weapon's name until the start of your next turn.
- Bubblechukka: This unit is wobbled. While a unit is wobbled, if it is attacking, its targets have the benefit of cover against those attacks.

Long Description:

Short Description: End of opponent Fight phase: visible enemy within 24" (not LO), D6: 1-3 D3 MW, 4-5 D3 MW, 6 D6 MW.
Long Description:
Boom Bomb: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding Lone Operative units) within 24" of this unit and roll one D6 for that unit:
- On a 1-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- On a 6, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Short Description: End of opponent Fight phase: D3 MW on 2+ and IGNORES COVER until your next turn.
Long Description:
Burna Bomb: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding Lone Operative and MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 18" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 2+:
- That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- That enemy unit cannot be hidden until the end of your next turn.
- Ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER] until the end of your next turn.

Short Description: Ranged vs MONSTER/VEHICLE +1 to wound.
Long Description: Go fer da Weak Spot: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

Drive-by Skorchin': In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 6" of this unit:
- That enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch stratagem until the end of the turn.

Short Description: If not fully visible because of this unit, target has cover.
